title: Object Storage: credit claim days
content:
Object Storage credit claim days is defined as follows: Inclusive outage-claim filing period after the incident closes; calendar days integer.

| Contract tier | Credit claim days |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | credit claim days: 30 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | credit claim days: 30 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | credit claim days: 30 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | credit claim days: 30 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | credit claim days: 30 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | credit claim days: 30 |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the credit claim days entry is 30.
